Control and review app permissions for best experience.
We use location to provide relevant insights like nearby places and context-aware assistance.
We analyze gallery images locally to surface insights on spend patterns, habits, and wellness. On Android 13+, we only request Images permission.
We analyze gallery images locally to surface insights on spend patterns, habits, and wellness. On Android 12 and below, we require storage read access.
With your explicit consent, we can analyze messages locally to detect transaction summaries for spend insights. This is optional.
Location access enables context-aware assistance (nearby places, reminders).
Media access lets the app analyze photos locally for insights (spend, habits, wellness).
SMS analysis is optional; with opt-in, messages are analyzed locally for transaction summaries.
Enable context-aware assistance by granting location access.
Allow image access for local insights; no cloud upload.
Optional: analyze messages locally to extract transaction summaries for spend insights. Disabled by default.
SMS analysis is optional and requires explicit opt-in.
You can enable or disable SMS analysis at any time in Permissions Center.
Tap to open Permissions Center and review or update app permissions.
If a permission is permanently denied, use "Open System Settings" to grant it.

This app requests access to your location and media to provide personalized insights. Analysis happens locally on your device whenever possible. You can manage permissions any time from the Permissions Center or the system Settings.
